ADVERT

"Don't open it," Rin said.

The courier bag was already humming.

Across the alley, something moved that was not rain. She ran and the city blurred and the footsteps behind her kept pace, patient, unhurried, as if whoever owned them already knew where she would stop.

She stopped. The humming stopped. The seal on the bag was whole again, and the alley was empty, and the rain had not touched her.
